title: Contents Packout & Storage Set Crew Charge for Oversized Items
content:
Contents Packout & Storage items too large for a vault need a set crew of their own at the furniture reset. **When the largest oversized item quantity on the job's oversized item storage lines is at least the oversized volume threshold, each oversized item carries the volume oversized set charge; when it is one, the oversized item carries the single oversized set charge; a job with no oversized item storage line carries no oversized set charge.**

| Largest oversized item quantity on the job's oversized item storage lines | Set crew charge |
|---|---|
| 2 or more (at least the oversized volume threshold) | that number of items times 120.00 |
| 1 | 145.00 for the single item |
| no oversized item storage line | none |

The quantity read is the largest quantity shown on any oversized item storage line of the job (pianos, sectionals, equipment stored per item per period).

**Cases.** Storage lines showing 1, 3 and 3 oversized items: the largest is 3, so 3 times 120.00, or 360.00. Lines showing only 1 item: 145.00.
